findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed multiple containers to be resting in bar hand sink. Discussed with PIC, items were removed from hand sink. Ensure hand sinks are solely being used for hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no test strips to be available within facility. Discussed with PIC, test strips will be purchased. Ensure test strips are available within facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed black mold to be present at mop sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
